items.information: Day 1 Events: 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, Clock, Megaminx, 4x4x4 Blindfolded Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, December 3rd is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, December 13th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.information: # The competition was cancelled due to an unexpected situation of lack of resources, which made it both impossible and pointless to carry it out. ¡Te damos la bienvenida a **San Rafael Open 2022**! El cupo **máximo de competidores será de 100**, pudiéndose anotar a todas las categorías que deseen, pagando 1 sola inscripción. Rogamos **puntualidad**, recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes de cada ronda, de esta manera evitamos demoras. --- Nuestro objetivo en este primer torneo oficial es que los competidores que asistan disfruten al máximo de la actividad, puedan aprender de sus compañeros, aprovechen a actualizar sus tiempos y sigan mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado desde el año 2018 Torneos, Talleres, Juegos, Actividades Cuberas, con nuestro Club Cuberos de Mendoza. Siempre deseábamos ofrecer un torneo oficial, pero los año en pandemia nos lo impidieron. Es por eso que soñamos de todo corazón que todos los competidores, familias, amigos, personas que asistan, disfruten de todo y se lleven una linda experiencia.
